story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.title: As you grew up...
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.sub: Before your present journey, you made a place for yourself in the world.
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.cutpurses: Ran with the Ash Whisperer's cutpurses
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.cutpurses.tal: As you grew up you ran with a gang of cutpurses who kept the Ash Whisperer's ways: quick hands, quicker feet and a shut mouth.
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.cutpurses.sho: Quick hands and a shut mouth.
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.levy: Marched with a realm's war camp
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.levy.tale: As you grew up you marched with the war camp of a realm that lives by the sword, and learned to lead the line.
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.levy.short: Leading the line in a war camp.
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.apprentice: Swept floors for a court wizard and read his books
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.apprentice.ta: As you grew up you swept a court wizard's floors and read his books when he wasn't looking.
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.hermit: Were taken in by an old elemental school
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.hermit.tale: As you grew up the elements began to answer when you called, and one of the old elemental schools took you in before you hurt someone.
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.hunted: Hunted with the Green Huntsman's folk
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.hunted.tale: As you grew up you hunted with the Green Huntsman's folk, who dress what they kill and waste none of it, and you rarely missed.
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.winter: Lived off the land through hard winters
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.winter.tale: As you grew up you lived off the land through hard winters that killed better folk than you. Nobody taught you. The wild did.
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.pits: Fought in the pits for coin
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.pits.tale: As you grew up you fought in the pits for coin, and learned to take a hit.
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.gunsmith.tale: As you grew up you served a ship's guns under her master gunner, and swabbed, loaded and laid every piece yourself.
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.messenger: Rode out of a realm's stables
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.messenger.tal: As you grew up you worked a realm's stables and its tilt-yard, and carried its messages on horseback from one end of the land to the other.
